map.在浏览器端安全解码 JWT 的 Header 与 Payload，无需上传令牌。: Safely decode a JWT's Header and Payload right in your browser, with no token upload.
map.解析 JWT 的三段结构，还原 Header 与 Payload 并可选校验签名: Parses the three-part JWT structure, restores the Header and Payload, and optionally verifies the signature.
map.，三段均为 Base64url，用点号分隔。: , all three segments are Base64url and separated by dots.
map.：对前两段做 Base64url 解码后 JSON.parse，还原算法与声明。: : Base64url-decode the first two segments and JSON.parse them to recover the algorithm and claims.
map.：解析不等于验证；必须校验 alg、exp、nbf、iss/aud，并拒绝: : parsing is not verification; you must validate alg, exp, nbf, iss/aud and reject
map.本工具仅在浏览器本地解析 JWT，不会将令牌发送到任何服务器。: This tool parses JWTs locally in your browser and never sends the token to any server.
map.Payload 中的签名部分不会被验证，仅做 Base64Url 解码展示。: The signature portion is not verified here; only Base64URL decoding is displayed.
map.请勿在公共环境粘贴包含敏感信息的正式令牌。: Do not paste production tokens containing sensitive data into public environments.
map.查看 JWT 三段（头/载荷/签名）中的声明。: Inspect the claims carried in the three JWT segments (header / payload / signature).
map.排查权限问题：解码后查看 Payload 里的 role/scope 与 exp: Debugging permission issues: after decoding, inspect role/scope and exp in the Payload to tell whether the token expired or a permission claim is missing, then decide between changing issuance or the front-end refresh logic.
map.`eyJhbG...` 三段以 . 分隔，Base64url 解码后：heade: `eyJhbG...` splits into three dot-separated parts; after Base64url decoding: header={"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}, payload={"sub":"123","exp":1700000000}.
map.解码 JWT 能验证真伪吗？: Does decoding a JWT verify its authenticity?
map.不能，仅看内容；验签需服务端密钥。: No, it only shows the contents; verifying the signature requires the server-side key.
map.解码出来的内容可信吗？: Can the decoded contents be trusted?
map.未经验签的 Payload 不可信。Base64url 只是编码，任何人都可伪造: An unverified Payload cannot be trusted. Base64url is just encoding, so anyone can forge a JWT that looks legitimate. Only after the signature verifies with the right key (symmetric) or public key (asymmetric) and exp/nbf/iss/aud all pass validation may its claims be used as a basis for authorization.
map.按点号切分令牌，段数不为 3 时提示格式错误。前两段各自做 base64url: Split the token by periods; when the segment count is not 3, report a format error. Base64url-decode the first two segments and parse them as JSON to get the header and payload; decode failure reports the error. Expiry: multiply exp by 1000 to build a date and compare with the current time — earlier means expired, otherwise not expired. Output alg (algorithm) and typ (token type), the pretty-printed header and payload, and the raw third segment signature.
